cn.t: Critics praise Daniel Fish's inventive docudrama, which transforms 1993 C-SPAN footage of Larry Kramer and Anthony Fauci into compelling theater through absurdist staging, exploring their unlikely friendship and the AIDS crisis with surprising resonance.
